# aaomsDigital — NEPSE Trading Analyzer

> Nepal's #1 TradingView-class trading analyzer platform. Live NEPSE data, interactive charts, technical indicators, IPO tracking, broker analytics, and educational price action classroom.

## About

aaomsDigital (kkpramod.com.np) provides free, real-time NEPSE (Nepal Stock Exchange) market analysis tools. Built for Nepali retail traders — no paid tips, no broker referrals, pure education and data.

## Key Pages

- **Home** — https://kkpramod.com.np — Platform overview, live NEPSE summary
- **NEPSE Screener** — https://kkpramod.com.np/nepse — Live stock board, gainers/losers, screens, TradingView charts, technical indicators
- **AVNEPSE Live Desk** — https://kkpramod.com.np/aavnepse — Multi-source V1-V5 live market data desk
- **MoneyControl** — https://kkpramod.com.np/moneycontrol — Aggregated NEPSE dashboard with heatmap, IPO, brokers, notices, classroom iframes
- **Heatmap** — https://kkpramod.com.np/heatmap — Visual NEPSE sector heatmap
- **IPO Dashboard** — https://kkpramod.com.np/ipo — Current and upcoming IPO/FPO/allotment tracking
- **Brokers** — https://kkpramod.com.np/brokers — Broker directory and floor sheet analytics
- **Notices** — https://kkpramod.com.np/notices — NEPSE and company announcements
- **Price Action Classroom** — https://kkpramod.com.np/classroom — Interactive candlestick and price action education with real NEPSE charts
- **aaomsDigital** — https://kkpramod.com.np/digital — Digital services and web development
- **Gurukul** — https://kkpramod.com.np/gurukul — Trading education hub
- **e-aaoms** — https://kkpramod.com.np/e-aaoms — Digital billing and receipt platform

## AI & LLM Policy

- This site is human-authored educational content
- No AI-generated trading advice or tips
- Market data sourced from Merolagani, yonepse, ShareSansar, and NEPSE API
- Charts powered by TradingView lightweight charts
- Free to use — no paywalls on educational content

## Contact

- **Website:** https://kkpramod.com.np
- **Email:** info@kkpramod.com.np
- **Location:** Nepal

## Tech Stack

- Node.js + Express (zero-dependency)
- Vanilla JavaScript (no framework)
- TradingView Lightweight Charts
- Progressive Web App (PWA)
- JSON file storage (no database)
